name: Rachel Green
summary: She starts as a runaway bride and grows into an independent New York woman with a career, courage, and unforgettable style.
personality: Warm, stylish, determined, and braver than she first appears.
facts: Starts over in New York after leaving her wedding.
Builds a real fashion career from the ground up.
Her confidence grows one choice at a time.

name: Monica Geller
summary: The heart of the group: a chef, host, loyal friend, and the person most likely to turn a casual evening into a perfectly planned event.
personality: Organized, generous, competitive, and deeply loyal.
facts: Her apartment is the group's unofficial home base.
She turns cooking and hosting into love languages.
She notices every detail, including the crumbs.

quote.text: Welcome to the real world. It sucks. You're gonna love it.

name: Phoebe Buffay
summary: Warm, surprising, and wonderfully original. Phoebe brings music, honesty, and a little mystery into every Central Perk visit.
personality: Creative, honest, spiritual, and impossible to predict.
facts: Performs songs at Central Perk with total confidence.
Says the strange thing everyone else is afraid to say.
Balances chaos with a surprisingly strong moral compass.

quote.text: They don't know that we know they know we know.

name: Ross Geller
summary: A romantic dinosaur expert with big feelings, dramatic timing, and one of the show's most quoted relationship debates.
personality: Academic, emotional, romantic, and accidentally dramatic.
facts: Works as a paleontologist and professor.
Can turn furniture moving into a legendary scene.
Often means well, even when the delivery goes sideways.

name: Chandler Bing
summary: Sarcasm is his armor, friendship is his language, and his best moments prove that humor can be very soft underneath.
personality: Sarcastic, tender, anxious, and quietly dependable.
facts: Uses jokes to survive almost every uncomfortable moment.
Grows into one of the show's most emotionally open characters.
Could this be a more quotable friend?

quote.text: I'm not great at the advice. Can I interest you in a sarcastic comment?

name: Joey Tribbiani
summary: Charming, loyal, food-focused, and full of heart. Joey brings the easiest laugh and the biggest appetite.
personality: Playful, affectionate, optimistic, and very serious about food.
facts: Dreams big as an actor and celebrates every small win.
Loves his friends with uncomplicated sincerity.
Has firm boundaries when sandwiches are involved.
